editorial.blurb: Authentic Szechuan cuisine from a Beijing-trained chef, hidden in a mall basement but delivering some of the best spiced and numbing dishes in Chinatown.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the peppercorn fish fillet (藤椒活鱼) or boiled beef (水煮牛) if you want to experience what keeps customers coming back repeatedly; note they're closed Wednesdays, and generous portions mean asking for a free takeout box is standard practice.
